scripts.text:
[Dophe]
This teleporter is connected to Eclage.
It'll be destroyed once our operation is over, but for now it's something we cannot live without.
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
这台传送器连接着埃克拉珠。
行动结束后它就会被销毁，但眼下它是不可或缺的。

scripts.text: Use the teleporter to move to Eclage.
scripts.translation: 使用传送器前往埃克拉珠

scripts.text: Move to Eclage.
scripts.translation: 前往埃克拉珠

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Do not use the teleporter.
scripts.translation: 不使用传送器

scripts.text: Move to Eclage.
scripts.translation: 前往埃克拉珠

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
This teleporter is connected to the recently discovered hideout of the Demon God.
Only those allowed to enter the hideout can use this teleporter.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
这台传送器连接着最近发现的恶魔之王藏身处。
只有获准进入藏身处的人才能使用。

scripts.text:
This teleporter is connected to the recently discovered hideout of the Demon God.
Do you want to use it?
scripts.translation:
这台传送器连接着最近发现的恶魔之王藏身处。
要使用吗？

scripts.text: Move to the Demon God's hideout.
scripts.translation: 前往恶魔之王的藏身处

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Do not use the teleporter.
scripts.translation: 不使用传送器

scripts.text: Use the teleporter to move to the Demon God's hideout.
scripts.translation: 使用传送器前往恶魔之王的藏身处

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
有什么事？

scripts.text: What's that teleporter?
scripts.translation: 那台传送器是什么？

scripts.text: Why is it so crowded in here?
scripts.translation: 这里为什么这么拥挤？

scripts.text: Demon God's hideout?
scripts.translation: 恶魔的藏身处？

scripts.text: Goodbye.
scripts.translation: 再见

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
It's connected to the recently discovered hideout the of Demon God.
It's scientifically designed to send its user directly to the Dimensional Crack where his hideout is.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
它连接着最近发现的恶魔之王藏身处。经过科学设计，能将使用者直接送到藏身处所在的次元裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Many a warrior already left to the hideout.
So long as Morocc exists, Yggdrasil is not safe. I'm going to join the Expedition.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
许多战士已经前往藏身处了。
只要梦罗克还存在，世界树就不得安宁。我要加入远征队。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
It turns out Demon God ran from Morocc to hide out in our dimension.
He has to be dealt with, either banished back to his realm or destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
恶魔之王从梦罗克逃来，躲进了我们的次元。必须解决他：要么放逐回原来的领域，要么将其消灭。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
If you want to join the Expedition to defeat the Demon God, then use this teleporter.
It'll send you directly to the Expedition Camp.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
想加入讨伐恶魔之王的远征队，就使用这台传送器。
它会直接把你送到远征营地。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
You know the Dimensional Crack, don't you? Recently it's been revealed that the Crack is made up of dimensional passageways.
We can now use those passageways to explore inside the Crack.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
你知道次元裂缝吧？最近发现裂缝是由次元通道构成的。
现在我们可以利用那些通道探索裂缝内部。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Originally the Crack was created by the Demon God to aid in his escape,
so it'd been thought investigating the Crack could locate him.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
起初，恶魔之王为了逃跑而制造了裂缝，
所以人们认为调查裂缝就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
And it was; finally his hideout has been discovered.
His traces and his demon soldiers are sighted mainly around the giant hill in the center.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
结果确实如此，终于发现了他的藏身处。
他的踪迹和恶魔士兵主要出现在中央的巨大山丘周围。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
If you want more details, then you should visit the actual site.
Just use the teleporter over there.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
想了解更多详情，就亲自去现场看看吧。
使用那边的传送器即可。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
May Yggdrasil bless you.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
愿世界树保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Combat Laphine]
I'm nervous.
scripts.translation:
[战斗中的拉菲尼]
好紧张啊。

scripts.text:
[Combat Laphine]
I hope I can return in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[战斗中的拉菲尼]
希望能全身而退。

scripts.text:
[Combat Laphine]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[战斗中的拉菲尼]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Combat Laphine]
Shush.
scripts.translation:
[战斗中的拉菲尼]
嘘。

scripts.text:
[Combat Laphine]
Mwa hah hah, it's time for me to shine!
scripts.translation:
[战斗中的拉菲尼]
哇哈哈，终于轮到本小姐大显身手了！

scripts.text:
[Combat Laphine]
I must have been out of my mind when I decided to join the army. Sigh, why does the Door to Verities have to be so high up there?
scripts.translation:
[战斗中的拉菲尼]
当初决定参军时，我一定是脑子坏掉了。唉，真理之门为什么建得那么高？

scripts.text:
[Commander Laphine]
Evil must be nipped in the butt.
You're unexpected visitors from the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼指挥官]
邪恶必须扼杀在萌芽之中。
你们是来自米德加尔特大陆的意外访客。

scripts.text:
[Commander Laphine]
If you  are the cause doom to ourselves OR Yggdrasil, then we won't hesitate to fight you.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼指挥官]
如果你们威胁到我们或世界树的安危，我们绝不会手下留情。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
Did you read the latest issue of the Door to Verities magazine?
Was Avant's new teleporter really featured in it?
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
你看过最新一期《真理之门》杂志吗？
阿旺的新传送器真的刊登在上面了吗？

scripts.text:
[Armandi]
Yes, just the basic principles and the information relevant to the Humans.
I didn't quite understand it all.
scripts.translation:
[阿曼迪]
是的，只是一些基本原理和对人类有用的信息。
我并没有完全看懂。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
I wonder if this means Avant has finally decided to pursue his interest in research activities.
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
不知道这是不是意味着阿旺终于决定投身研究了。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
Hey, Human.
Were you eavesdropping on us? Well, though it wasn't like we're discussing secrets.
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
嘿，人类。
你在偷听我们说话吗？不过，我们也没聊什么秘密。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
Oh, right. Are you too going there?
You know, the hideout of the Demon God who created some of the Space Time Dimensional Cracks has recently been discovered.
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
哦，对了，你也要去那里吗？
最近发现了制造时空裂缝的恶魔之王的藏身处。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
If you're curious, then use that teleporter to the hideout over there.
There will be quite a spectacle to watch.
Oh, just so you know, you might be throwing away your life. *Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
好奇的话，就用那边的传送器去他的藏身处看看。
那里一定很壮观。
不过先说好，你可能会丢掉性命哦。*咯咯*

scripts.text:
[Armandi]
Lemony, you really need to work on improving your personality.
Tsk, tsk.
scripts.translation:
[阿曼迪]
莱蒙妮，你真该改改自己的性格。
啧啧。

scripts.text:
[Armandi]
I hope the Interdimensional Device won't take a heavy toll on the world.
By the way, Avant never fails to amaze me.
scripts.translation:
[阿曼迪]
希望次元装置不会给世界带来太大负担。
顺便说一句，阿旺总能让我惊叹。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
Ack, I hate that guy.
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
啊，我讨厌那个家伙。

scripts.text:
[Armandi]
Avant may be repulsive,
but he's the best at what he does.
scripts.translation:
[阿曼迪]
阿旺虽然令人讨厌，
但他确实是这方面的顶尖专家。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
That, I agree.
Only he could pull off this kind of teleporter.
Why is he helping the Mayor, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
这点我同意。
只有他能造出这种传送器。
他为什么要帮市长呢？

scripts.text:
[Armandi]
When I asked him, he mumbled something about repentance.
I can only guess it has something to do with the Mayor's birth.
scripts.translation:
[阿曼迪]
我问过他，他含糊地提到什么忏悔。
我只能猜这和市长的出身有关。

scripts.text:
[Armandi]
I wanted to ask more, but he looked down his nose at me.
Sigh, it's unfair such a jerk is considered the best in magical science.
scripts.translation:
[阿曼迪]
我本想多问几句，可他对我不屑一顾。
唉，这种混蛋居然被视为魔法科学界的顶尖人物，真不公平。

scripts.text:
[Lemony]
You can always study hard to beat him.
scripts.translation:
[莱蒙妮]
你努力学习，总有一天能超过他。
